notes.title: Development Update - Side Paths & Realm 4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while now since our last game update, so we're posting this development update across all our platforms, rather than only Patreon, so everyone can easily see where we're at and know what to expect in the coming months.

If you've followed our previous development updates, you'll know we've been working on the side paths and Realm 4 simultaneously. The whole team's been familiarising ourselves with Blender, overhauling the quality of environments, adapting to our new workflow, all with the goal of ensuring the quality of the game improves. When we first decided to change our 3D software from Daz 3D to Blender, we'd hoped the transition would be much faster and easier. It has taken us longer than anticipated to be here fully, but we're confident that we're now past the most challenging part, and we hope that what we release going forward feels worth the wait.

Currently, all focus is on The Seven Realms, so everyone who was working on ACTC is now focused on TSR to help us release things ASAP.

[h1]Side Paths[/h1]
As the side paths will be our next game update, we'll start here. We'll recap some of the info we've shared previously to ensure this post gives you the full view of where we're at.

We released three side paths earlier this year. The next update will contain the remaining 13. They relate to the following characters:

[i]Continuations:[/i] [b]Kagome[/b], [b]Yuki[/b], and [b]Gina[/b]*.

*Gina's will have two variations depending on the allies you chose in Realm 2.

[i]New ones with one side path:[/i] [b]Kali[/b], [b]Mei & Ling Guo[/b], [b]Seraphina[/b], and [b]Zyair[/b].

[i]New ones with two side paths:[/i] [b]Leyala[/b], [b]Naya[/b], and [b]Tasha[/b].

For those with fewer paths here, they will receive more in the future Realms, to ensure all relevant characters have roughly the same amount of side path content.

In total, the remaining 13 side paths contain 14 NSFW animations and about 1,350 images. The number of images is equal to almost half of a Realm.

The animations have been animated and lit, and we have rendered about half of them. We're currently rendering the remaining few.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/6ae034d5aaa66dcb3c5bee330bd85d3c9f49ddc4.jpg[/img]
The still images are all posed, and we are working on the lighting for them now. This will be the primary focus over the next couple of months. This is our first time lighting so many still images for one update, and our first full update in Blender, so we don't know our pace just yet, but we hope to launch the side paths update in early November. This will first come to Patreon, and will follow on our other platforms.

Alongside the side paths update, we will also launch a Turkish translation for the game.

Once development is complete on the side paths, we'll jump straight into Realm 4.

[h1]Realm 4[/h1]
Our planned release schedule for Realm 4 differs slightly from that of Realms 1-3.

With Realms 1-3, we released around 10 separate game updates on Patreon and Itch. For Realm 4, we plan for four updates. On Steam, we still plan to release the whole Realm in one go, not in smaller chapters.

When Tae initially wrote Realm 4, she wrote it the same way as Realms 1-3, with 12 updates. To have bigger releases, we've decided to split these 12 updates into four (with each update being around x3 our typical Realm 1-3 updates). So each update will be significantly bigger. Having completed all of Realm 4's main story and made significant progress with the animations, we aim to maintain a good release pace now that we're back on track.

Here's what we've currently got done for Realm 4:

[list]
[*] All "safe-for-work" animations have been animated.

[*] We have animated NSFW animations for the first two updates.

[*] For the still images, all environments have been created, and the characters have had their bodies posed for all of Realm 4 (not including facial expressions and some other finishing touches, such as final outfits).

[*] Facial expressions have been posed for Updates 1 & 2, with Update 3 currently in progress and expected to be completed within a couple of weeks.
[/list]
Initially, we'd posed the mermaids with naked torsos, but this week we've been working on unique outfits for them. We're happy with how they've come out. We haven't shown off the Realm 4 ladies much yet, but we will start sharing more of them after we release the side paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/357b9ce95d95972301d938640bbbcfc1948fbafb.jpg[/img]
Hopefully, this all gives you a good idea of where we're at and what to expect. But if you have any questions, feel free to ask away below.

Thanks so much for your continued support and patience. Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]As part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], we have launched a demo for [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130/The_Seven_Realms_High_Lathin/]The Seven Realms - High Lathión[/url][/b].[/h2]

This demo covers around the first hour of the game, with three achievements to unlock, two lewd scenes to encounter and to preview our new glossary and updated user interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/903511f2b673e2b52c2ecb15281549659cbb52fb.jpg[/img]
For players coming from our [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/SeptCloudGames]Patreon[/url], you can also check out the immersive recap for the first time in this demo. This recaps the choices of the previous chapters and allows you to simulate your choices to fast-track a save into High Lathión.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/fa4d3d22f1908ed5228ba5a7464288243b7e0c3a.jpg[/img]
If you've played the previous chapters on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35112/The_Seven_Realms__Realm_1__2_Complete_Collection/]Steam[/url] or [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/SeptCloudGames]Patreon[/url], you can import your Realm 2 exported save into this demo and continue your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9865fa39cc8188aee11aff6ad0965441ee4cb5d.jpg[/img]
Depending on who you chose as your allies in the previous chapter, some of the content available in the demo changes. You can use the immersive recap to simulate a save for both sides to experience all of the demo's content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/bf2e2ad057f3f7c87681be06e82159b32b6fe50e.jpg[/img]
You can download it now from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130/The_Seven_Realms_High_Lathin/]High Lathión store page[/url]. We hope you enjoy this preview before our full release next month.

notes.title: Our Immersive Recap!
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

The story of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130/The_Seven_Realms_High_Lathin/]The Seven Realms - High Lathión[/url][/b] continues the first two chapters: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154330/The_Seven_Realms__Realm_1_Terran/]Terran[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368280/The_Seven_Realms__Realm_2_Pythonium/]Pythonium[/url][/b].

If you have already played the first two parts, you can import your end-game save into High Lathión when it launches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/a9dcfe1a37701e7bcf5ba21147c2d60ff82c467e.jpg[/img]
If you do not have an exported save or are new to The Seven Realms, you can start with this instalment.

Over the last few weeks, we've been creating an immersive recap/save simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/839c927aa0af215c112691d0f4c3a156c26bd41a.jpg[/img]
[h3]What does that mean?[/h3]
When you select [b]New Game [/b]in High Lathión, you will be shown a recap that takes you through the events of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154330/The_Seven_Realms__Realm_1_Terran/][b]Terran[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368280/The_Seven_Realms__Realm_2_Pythonium/][b]Pythonium[/b][/url]. You can also select critical choices that will be carried into your new game.

We've enhanced the Terran images in the recap to match the style more closely to our later Realms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/620d569e92cb7342b0dbdc974d41841c2d837689.jpg[/img]
This feature will allow returning players to refresh their memories and for new players to jump straight into this Realm.

If you have any questions, let us know in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/1a77948e351e1306e63a599e6933d08979614c13.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Character Side Stories
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]

Today, we'll share more information about the side paths in High Lathión. [b](Note that the images in this post do not contain the final lighting or rendering, so they are not as they will appear in game.)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/4a0337ef07953402d0f574b253f76e9914d63d4f.jpg[/img]
In The Seven Realms, there are a vast number of characters. Not all of them will be central to the main plot of each realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/349f80400f54dce941c95543ced42ef244fe36dd.jpg[/img]
To ensure that no matter the contents of the main story, starting from this realm, numerous characters will have their own "side paths" for players to experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/6dcbc0aaa3eded982feb702f8263ccd291b38647.jpg[/img]
These side stories revolve around the love interests, harem members and a couple of other characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9c0f51ace90c00fd5914222f77e7fb4fee5a318.jpg[/img]
Some of these will be shorter, self-contained stories, while most others will be parts of a story that plays out across several realms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/0509984ad60922e150685c1a40ca45c5fa0e1580.jpg[/img]
We plan to include several of these in High Lathión when we release it on Steam; we will add others in a free update after the release.

The characters who will have a side path starting in this realm are:
[list]
[*] Leyala
[*] Kali
[*] Naya
[*] Gina
[*] Mei & Ling Guo
[*] Yuki
[*] Tasha
[*] Kagome
[*] Seraphina
[*] Lilin
[*] Zyair
[/list]
In the Zyair path, our supporters on [url=https://www.patreon.com/SeptCloudGames]Patreon[/url] voted for two custom women for Atlas to hook up with in this path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/d2637bd8138ea7485061867242c05d87be8023f6.jpg[/img]
We're excited to share these side stories with you soon!

We can't share videos of them here, but you can check out some previews we've shared on our [url=https://x.com/SeptCloudGames]Twitter[/url] page.

Adding these sounds helps bring the scenes to life, especially the lewd ones... We can't wait for you to check them out when High Lathión releases soon!

notes.title: Moon & Sun Elves!
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

[h3]Elves are the native and predominant species living in High Lathión.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/f7ee8ec10a035ca1ac457e9629d30b0aec17ed04.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/dffd2bdb711a3e32bdc8b12d9f5f9cd8cc3108bd.jpg[/img]
They are immortal, and once they surpass their first 100 years, it is common for them to stop keeping track of their age. They can still be killed, but time alone will not.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/6336b345bd7adadfd4e7afa7503f47563eeed3f5.jpg[/img]
Elves, with their pointy ears, healthy physique, and significant physical strength, are a formidable species. Their innate abilities enable them to perform varying degrees of lesser magic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/7261f4bde33e242a1e3b8e2ff802232a82c2b0bf.jpg[/img]
Elves are split into two distinct groups: [b]Moon Elves[/b] and [b]Sun Elves[/b].

Moon Elves have blue skin and are generally physically stronger than Sun Elves. Their [i]insides[/i] are generally much cooler than that of other species, too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/bd75e06d023765af3b5c79495b5a4aa92b4e938a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/eb9c6faa40fd849b83769cceeafc5968f05a8f92.jpg[/img]
Sun Elves have a yellow-brown skin tone, are typically more dexterous, and have more magical capabilities than Moon Elves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/39a4df759498901cf30566ddf10d1b7b3ecab375.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/3f2ac04acbaedab9285449d1dcc69618c90b2747.jpg[/img]
The two groups harbour a deep-rooted hatred for each other. Civil War consumed High Lathión for an eternity until the Sun Elf Queen and the Moon Elf King allied to unite the realm.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/7bd30cc40f369188e66bf045f45b45b2e45ffa66.jpg[/img]
Although the move was controversial, both monarchs are deeply respected by their people and have managed to bring a large degree of peace to the realm.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2b2d8eaa0a872366078430d73ad9a6fdd2c2af62.jpg[/img]
The upcoming realm introduces two new harem members. Morwen and Idril.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/622d279ab065ecbe4cc9b469fdf23d199a1282cd.jpg[/img]
We will share some more details about these two in posts soon!

notes.title: Development Update & Previews!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's been a while since we've shared a development update here on Steam.

We've been working hard to release early access updates on [url=https://www.patreon.com/SeptCloudGames]other platforms[/url] in preparation for the full Steam launch.

We are approaching the end of development of High Lathión's main story.

Once this is complete, we will implement the in-game side paths for numerous characters. We may release on Steam before completing all character side paths and then to add the remaining ones as a free update shortly after release.

We hope to launch High Lathión on Steam within the next two months. We will confirm specific release dates within the next few weeks.

The development cycle for this Realm has been far more ambitious than Realms 1 & 2. We hope that comes through to you in the overall quality of this new Realm. We are incredibly excited to share it with you all soon.

In the build-up to the launch, we plan to share more posts with information on the development and the lore surrounding The Seven Realms.

notes.title: High Lathión - The Next Chapter
notes.content:
[h3]We're excited to share some information on the next chapter of The Seven Realms: High Lathión. We plan to share more frequent development updates here; however, we will be sharing these in English only for now. Apologies to fans playing in different languages![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/fa4d3d22f1908ed5228ba5a7464288243b7e0c3a.jpg[/img]
The increase in the scope of High Lathión compared to Terran and Pythonium is significant. We are putting everything we've got into improving the graphics, storytelling, and overall player experience, and we can't wait to share more with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/7a6dece9fd4a65e02784cdfaf28e6e072206c12a.jpg[/img]
High Lathión is the realm of Elves. Harmony has been found after endless wars between the moon and sun elves, but something sinister begins to threaten that peace.

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130/The_Seven_Realms_High_Lathin/]Please consider adding the game to your wishlist. Doing so helps us enormously. Thanks for your support![/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/23b5ff3e80e5a27bda5bf868ae560d3b235f21aa.gif[/img]
[h1]New Characters[/h1]
Amongst several new exciting characters, including the Elven King & Queen, you will meet two new harem members.

[b]Morwen is the head servant in the royal Elven palace.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/16264081b7f6a4b5e2eb7062c86a560de04b3b5a.jpg[/img]
[b]Idril is a high-ranking member of the Elven military.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9865fa39cc8188aee11aff6ad0965441ee4cb5d.jpg[/img]
Both of them will assist you in your journey, as you will assist them... and enjoy a few romantic encounters along the way...

[h1]Images[/h1]
We've put in a lot of work to enhance the images in High Lathión. Compared to the darker tones in Terran and Pythonium, High Lathión is a bright, and vibrant realm, with images created to reflect its beauty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2c78be64beb66e37214e781d924818178a6b4197.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/a7e220b06bc8b02659cf2d1445cb28319260c433.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/c03d8d1afef7ae6d4bbbb4da21012413b8eac14a.jpg[/img]
As we did with the climax in Pythonium, we're taking our action sequences to the next level to show off the power behind these supernatural beings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2a899524ca84cfc20db08462f9e847ef51bddfb1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/643abd6eac7a5a57f0d102a0004c0815d299d7cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/bf2e2ad057f3f7c87681be06e82159b32b6fe50e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Animations[/h1]
The animations have always been important to us. In High Lathión, we're upgrading them further than before. While most animations featured are sexual, we also have short cinematics to immerse you further in the world with these characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/552d4d95e0a992dc1ab58857a2f5429c659510c2.gif[/img]

Also, in this realm, we are adding more sounds. This includes sound effects during gameplay and all animations, especially the sexual ones. We'll share more on this in due course. If you want a preview of some voiced animations, you can check them out on our [url=https://twitter.com/SeptCloudGames]Twitter[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/335ec7b4574b933b629872fc1159809c86cbecfb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/5b1e2ab9d2b905a491d0c1277420e7947c1d9390.gif[/img]

[h1]Music[/h1]
We love music and believe having a unique soundtrack enhances the gaming experience. All of the tracks featured in Terran and Pythonum were composed for the game. With High Lathión, we've taken this further by creating a whole new soundtrack for the realm, with longer individual music tracks. While some of the previous main themes still feature throughout, the new music, designed specifically for the Elven realm, should give the story a fresh feel when playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/e28694dc1932c092b674532ebdfde1ca6bf39521.png[/img]
[h1]User Interface & Glossary[/h1]
The user interface has also received a complete overhaul. We have completely redesigned the look to fit the theme of the Elven realm. Much of the functionality is similar, so it should still feel familiar if you've already played Terran and Pythonium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/60df43f56bac6046bbb112fb62c94db76b00ff9f.png[/img]
Completing specific actions will unlock new wallpapers for the title menu as you play. Once unlocked, you can change these at will. Will you keep your favourite character there once unlocked, or will you rotate these each time you play?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/625133a96726f97462e3ec45425364d24920b332.gif[/img]

We're also adding an evolving glossary. The glossary will update as you play and reveal more information, so you can easily catch yourself back up even if you return to the game after a little while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/e69558bd25359c6396427ece73c9d42716cca689.gif[/img]

Check details of character, species, realms or other key terms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/d70e8d0c3267ab3f9cce77637805a4884e5787ef.png[/img]

[h1]Side paths[/h1]
Another exciting new addition to High Lathión is the character side paths.

These are side stories within the game that focus on individual characters. Will you help Gina save her brother? Will you help Yuki grow more independent? Spend time with various characters to develop your relationships further.

With a growing cast of characters, not all of them will be involved in every section of the main story, so these side paths ensure you spend time with your favourite characters, even if they aren't at the centre of the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/8007aff34b37ec5b0051f866fbef9874d34d7665.gif[/img]

We can't wait to share more with you!

As soon as we have a definite release window, we will communicate it, but our current objective is to release High Lathión before the end of this year.

What are you looking forward to the most? Let us know if you have any questions!
